program.progression: Add load once you can do 2 more reps with good form [notes-program-design-1].
program.rationale:
This program is designed for a beginner client aiming to build muscle, using dumbbells and a bench, three days a week. Each session is a full-body workout, which is suitable for beginners [notes-program-design-2, iversen2021-time-efficient-3].

For muscle growth (hypertrophy), moderate loads with roughly 6-12 repetitions per set and 1-3 minutes of rest are recommended [notes-program-design-1]. Beginners can start with 1-3 sets per exercise [notes-program-design-1]. This program uses 3 sets of 8-12 reps with 60-90 seconds rest for most exercises to align with these guidelines. Core exercises like planks and carries are prescribed for time or distance.

Bodyweight exercises were excluded as per the client's request. The "vertical pull" slot on Day 1 was replaced with a "horizontal pull" due to the lack of suitable equipment for vertical pull exercises (a pull-up bar or resistance bands would enable vertical pull exercises).
